name: Thai "Massaman Beef Curry" Sloppy Joes with Potato, Peanuts & Crispy Onions

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (2 inch) piece ginger root
1 medium yellow potato
½ lime
½ small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Peel and roughly chop ginger; peel and roughly chop garlic. Place both in a blender.
Peel and roughly chop shallots. Add to the blender along with water, lemongrass paste, and spices. Blend on high until curry paste is smooth, then set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp lemongrass paste
¾ tsp cumin, ground
¾ tsp coriander, ground
½ tsp cinnamon, ground
½ tsp crushed red pepper
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp cardamom, ground
⅛ tsp cloves, ground
⅛ tsp nutmeg, ground

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add beef and salt; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer beef to a plate. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ lb lean ground beef
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and small dice potato and set aside.
Return skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat. Add curry paste and cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant and dark in color, 2-3 minutes.

Add potato, coconut milk, sugar, fish sauce, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Stir to combine the curry and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, until potato is fork-tender and curry is thickened, 10-12 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk
1 tbsp brown sugar
2 tsp fish sauce
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, juice lime into a small bowl. Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add half to the bowl, stir to combine, and set aside. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
When the potato is done, return beef to the skillet and stir to combine. Continue to cook until beef is warmed through, 2-3 minutes more.
Add lime juice-cilantro mixture to the skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Toast buns if desired. Roughly chop peanuts.
To serve, place bottom half of each bun on a plate. Top with saucy beef, French fried onions, peanuts, and reserved cilantro, then close with the top half of each bun. Enjoy!
